title: Google Drive for desktop data
whyItMatters: Drive for desktop keeps account data and a local cache of streamed files under LocalAppData. A handover should account for the cached copies and the account sign-in.
source: Google Drive Help, Use Google Drive for desktop: Drive for desktop stores its local data under %LOCALAPPDATA%/Google/DriveFS - https://support.google.com/drive/answer/10838124
notes: The synced Drive files appear as a separate drive letter, which cannot be expressed as a path rule, so only the profile and cache are covered. Streamed placeholders are counted, not hydrated.

cleanup.exportFirst: Open any file that exists only in the streamed Drive folder and save a copy to a drive you keep.
cleanup.signOut: In Drive for desktop settings disconnect the account, so it stops syncing this PC.
steps: Confirm the files you need are saved somewhere else.
Quit Google Drive from the notification area.
Disconnect the account in the Drive settings.
Uninstall Google Drive from Settings > Apps > Installed apps.
Delete the folder named in the plan if it is still there.
cleanup.risk: Cached and streamed copies leave this PC. Files stay in the Google account, and online-only files were never downloaded.
cleanup.source: Google Drive Help, Customize Drive for desktop settings: https://support.google.com/drive/answer/13470231
